#Fig 5
# maslin -- 4 factors - prev 0.3  age, race, ER, CTC
```{r}
#=========================================================
# maaslin3 in species level  --age + ER + race + ctc
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ctc2 = case_when(
      CTC_count_cat %in% c("0","0-5") ~ "0–5",
      CTC_count_cat == ">5" ~ ">5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

meta_ctc <- meta %>% filter(!is.na(ctc2))

physeq_ctc <- prune_samples(rownames(meta_ctc), physeq)
#set refer
meta_ctc$ctc2 <- factor(meta_ctc$ctc2)
meta_ctc$ctc2 <- relevel(meta_ctc$ctc2, ref = "0–5")

# maaslin function
library(maaslin3)
run_single_factor <- function(physeq_obj, metadata_df, factor_name, out_dir) {
  
  # input files
  abund <- as.data.frame(t(phyloseq::otu_table(physeq_obj)))
  meta  <- metadata_df[, factor_name, drop = FALSE]

  #  Maaslin3 
  maaslin3(
    input_data    = abund,
    input_metadata = meta,
    output        = out_dir,
    formula       = paste0("~ ", factor_name),
    min_prevalence = 0.5, #prevalence
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    augment = TRUE,
    standardize = TRUE,
    median_comparison_abundance = TRUE,
    median_comparison_prevalence = FALSE,
    max_significance = 0.25,
    cores = 4
    )
  
  cat("Finished:", factor_name, "\n")
}

# 1 age
run_single_factor(
  physeq_obj = physeq,
  metadata_df = meta,
  factor_name = "age_group",
  out_dir = "../Output/Maaslin3/age_group_only_0.5/"
)

# 2 race
run_single_factor(
  physeq_obj = physeq,
  metadata_df = meta,
  factor_name = "race",
  out_dir = "../Output/Maaslin3/race_only_0.5/"
)

# 3 ER
run_single_factor(
  physeq_obj = physeq,
  metadata_df = meta,
  factor_name = "ER",
  out_dir = "../Output/Maaslin3/ER_only_0.5/"
)

# ctc
run_single_factor(
  physeq_obj = physeq_ctc,
  metadata_df = meta_ctc,
  factor_name = "ctc2",
  out_dir = "../Output/Maaslin3/ctc2_only_0.5/"
)
```

# maaslin plot -- lollipop plot , refer to ROC paper ----age
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(stringr)
library(colorspace)


## meta data
physeq <- readRDS("../Output/physeq.rds")

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)
otu  <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(physeq)))
tax  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq))


##  Maaslin3 result for age_group
file_age <- "../Output/Maaslin3/age_group_only_0.5/all_results.tsv"
df <- read_tsv(file_age, show_col_types = FALSE)

## Keep only abundance rows
df <- df %>% filter(str_detect(model, "abundance"))

## Extract species name (last element)
df$Species <- sapply(strsplit(df$feature, ";"), tail, 1)
df$Species <- gsub("_", " ", df$Species)

## Extract phylum (second rank)
df$Phylum <- sapply(strsplit(df$feature, ";"), function(x) x[2])

## Order by coefficient 
df <- df %>% arrange(coef)
df$Species <- factor(df$Species, levels = df$Species)


## Compute prevalence 
taxa_keep <- df$feature
otu_sub <- otu[, taxa_keep, drop = FALSE]

calc_prev <- function(vec, grp) tapply(vec > 0, grp, mean) * 100
prev_mat  <- sapply(otu_sub, calc_prev, grp = meta$age_group)
prev_df   <- as.data.frame(t(prev_mat))

prev_df$feature <- rownames(prev_df)
colnames(prev_df)[1:2] <- c(">=50", "<50")

df <- df %>% left_join(prev_df, by = "feature")

## Format long version for right panel
df_prev <- df %>%
  select(Species, `<50`, `>=50`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`<50`, `>=50`),
               names_to = "Group",
               values_to = "Prevalence") %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = levels(df$Species)),
    Group   = factor(Group, levels = c("<50", ">=50"))
  )

## colors 
## left coef panel
df$coef_dir <- ifelse(df$coef >= 0, "pos", "neg")
df$coef_dir <- factor(df$coef_dir, levels = c("neg", "pos"))

coef_cols <- c(
  "neg" = "#D5A021",  
  "pos" = "#6C4E09"   
)

## star marking on significant taxa
df$signif <- df$qval_joint < 0.25

## Phylum colors
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#D7B348",  
  "Firmicutes"       = "#308178",  
  "Actinobacteriota" = "#D45740"   
)
## Prevalence colors
prev_cols <- c(
  "<50"  = "#D5A021",
  ">=50" = "#6C4E09"
)


##  Left panel
p_coef <- ggplot(df, aes(y = Species)) +
  geom_segment(aes(
    x = 0, xend = coef,
    yend = Species,
    color = coef_dir
  ), linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(aes(x = coef, color = coef_dir),
             size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    data = subset(df, signif),
    aes(x = coef, y = Species, label = "*"),
    nudge_x = 0.02 * diff(range(df$coef, na.rm = TRUE)), 
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = coef_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Coefficient", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black")
  )


##  Middle panel
df_phylum <- df %>% dplyr::select(Species, Phylum)

p_phylum <- ggplot(df_phylum, aes(y = Species, x = 1, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

##  Right panel
df_prev <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, `<50`, `>=50`) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`<50`, `>=50`),
    names_to  = "Group",
    values_to = "Prevalence"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = levels(df$Species)),
    Group   = factor(Group, levels = c("<50", ">=50"))
  )

#
bottom_labels <- c(
  "<50"  = "Prevalence in <50 (%)",
  ">=50" = "Prevalence in ≥50 (%)"
)
df_prev$Group <- as.character(df_prev$Group)
df_prev$Group[df_prev$Group == "Prevalence in <50 (%)"]  <- "<50"
df_prev$Group[df_prev$Group == "Prevalence in ≥50 (%)"] <- ">=50"
df_prev$Group <- factor(df_prev$Group, levels = c("<50", ">=50"))

p_prev <- ggplot(df_prev,
                 aes(x = Prevalence, y = Species, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(color = NA, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = prev_cols, guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(. ~ Group, switch = "x",
             labeller = labeller(Group = bottom_labels)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.placement  = "outside",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank()
  )

##  Merge 
library(cowplot)
p_all <- plot_grid(
  p_coef,
  p_phylum,
  p_prev,
  nrow = 1,
  align = "h",
  axis  = "tb",
  rel_widths = c(1.3, 0.05, 0.8)
)
p_all
ggsave('../Output/Maaslin3/p_age_all.pdf', p_all, width = 7, height = 4)
```

# ctc
```{r}

## meta
physeq <- readRDS("../Output/physeq.rds")

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq), check.names = FALSE)

## filter NA 
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ctc2 = case_when(
      CTC_count_cat %in% c("0", "0-5") ~ "0–5",
      CTC_count_cat %in% c(">5")       ~ ">5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctc2))

meta$ctc2 <- factor(meta$ctc2, levels = c("0–5", ">5"))

otu  <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(physeq)))[rownames(meta), , drop = FALSE]
tax  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq))

## Maaslin3 result for CTC2
file_ctc <- "../Output/Maaslin3/ctc2_only_0.5/all_results.tsv"
df <- read_tsv(file_ctc, show_col_types = FALSE)

df <- df %>% filter(str_detect(model, "abundance"))

df$Species <- sapply(strsplit(df$feature, ";"), tail, 1)
df$Species <- gsub("_", " ", df$Species)

df$Phylum <- sapply(strsplit(df$feature, ";"), function(x) x[2])

df <- df %>% arrange(coef)
df$Species <- factor(df$Species, levels = df$Species)


## Prevalence 
taxa_keep <- df$feature
otu_sub <- otu[, taxa_keep, drop = FALSE]

calc_prev <- function(vec, grp) tapply(vec > 0, grp, mean) * 100
prev_mat  <- sapply(otu_sub, calc_prev, grp = meta$ctc2)
prev_df   <- as.data.frame(t(prev_mat))

prev_df$feature <- rownames(prev_df)
colnames(prev_df)[1:2] <- c("0–5", ">5")

df <- df %>% left_join(prev_df, by = "feature")

df_prev <- df %>%
  select(Species, `0–5`, `>5`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`0–5`, `>5`),
               names_to = "Group",
               values_to = "Prevalence") %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = levels(df$Species)),
    Group   = factor(Group, levels = c("0–5", ">5"))
  )


##  Colors
## Coef 
df$coef_dir <- ifelse(df$coef >= 0, "pos", "neg")
df$coef_dir <- factor(df$coef_dir, levels = c("neg", "pos"))
## CTC color 
ctc_cols <- c(
  "neg" = "#F7A280",   
  "pos" = "#B33C1E"   
)
prev_cols <- c(
  "0–5" = "#F7A280",
  ">5"  = "#B33C1E"
)
## Significance star
df$signif <- df$qval_joint < 0.25
## Phylum colors
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#D7B348",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#308178",
  "Actinobacteriota" = "#D45740"
)
## Strip labels
bottom_labels <- c(
  "0–5" = "Prevalence in 0–5 (%)",
  ">5"  = "Prevalence in >5 (%)"
)


## Left 
p_coef <- ggplot(df, aes(y = Species)) +
  geom_segment(aes(
    x = 0, xend = coef,
    yend = Species,
    color = coef_dir
  ), linewidth = 1.0) +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = coef, color = coef_dir), size = 3) +

  geom_text(
    data = subset(df, signif),
    aes(x = coef, y = Species, label = "*"),
    nudge_x = 0.02 * diff(range(df$coef, na.rm = TRUE)),
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = ctc_cols, guide = "none") +

  labs(x = "Coefficient", y = NULL) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black")
  )

## Middle
df_phylum <- df %>% select(Species, Phylum)

p_phylum <- ggplot(df_phylum, aes(y = Species, x = 1, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


## Right
p_prev <- ggplot(df_prev,
                 aes(x = Prevalence, y = Species, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(color = NA, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = prev_cols, guide = "none") +
  
  facet_grid(. ~ Group, switch = "x",
             labeller = labeller(Group = bottom_labels)) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )


## merge
library(cowplot)

p_ctc <- plot_grid(
  p_coef,
  p_phylum,
  p_prev,
  nrow = 1,
  align = "h",
  axis  = "tb",
  rel_widths = c(1.3, 0.05, 0.8)
)

p_ctc
ggsave('../Output/Maaslin3/p_ctc_all.pdf', p_ctc, width = 7, height = 4)
```

#color legend
```{r}
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#D7B348",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#308178",
  "Actinobacteriota" = "#D45740"
)

library(ggplot2)

df_legend_phy <- data.frame(
  Phylum = names(phylum_colors),
  x = 1, y = 1:length(phylum_colors)
)

p_legend_phy <- ggplot(df_legend_phy, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.8, height = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Save legend only
legend_phy <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p_legend_phy + guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Phylum"))
)

ggsave("../Output/Maaslin3/legend_phylum.pdf",
       legend_phy, width = 3, height = 3)

# group legend
age_cols <- c("<50" = "#D5A021", ">=50" = "#6C4E09")
race_cols <- c("Black" = "#83B4E1", "White" = "#1F5A97")
er_cols <- c("Negative" = "#C6A7E8", "Positive" = "#5D3F8C")
ctc_cols <- c("0–5" = "#F7A280", ">5" = "#B33C1E")
make_legend <- function(col_vec, title) {
  df <- data.frame(
    Group = names(col_vec),
    x = 1, y = seq_along(col_vec)
  )
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=Group)) +
    geom_tile(width=0.8, height=0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_vec) +
    theme_void()
  
  cowplot::get_legend(
    p + guides(fill = guide_legend(title = title))
  )
}

legend_age  <- make_legend(age_cols,  "Age at MBC diagnosis")
legend_race <- make_legend(race_cols, "Race")
legend_er   <- make_legend(er_cols,   "ER status")
legend_ctc  <- make_legend(ctc_cols,  "CTC categories")

legend_all <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend_age, legend_race, legend_er, legend_ctc,
  ncol = 1, align = "v"
)

ggsave("../Output/Maaslin3/legend_groups_all.pdf",
       legend_all, width = 4, height = 8)

```
